# Zeno

> Zeno is a subscription tracker for iOS and Android. It finds the subscriptions you pay for in billing receipts from an inbox you connect (read-only) and in bank-statement CSVs you import, warns you before each renewal, and walks you through cancelling. No bank login required.

Status: pre-launch. The iOS and Android apps are not in the App Store or Play Store yet; people can join the waitlist at https://zenoapp.in.

How it works:
- Discovery: you start a scan of billing receipts in an inbox you connect (read-only), or import a statement CSV from any bank. A scan runs when you tap scan, not in the background. Charges are matched against a catalogue of 509 services. You can also add subscriptions by hand.
- Reminders: 7 days, 3 days and on the day of each renewal.
- Cancelling: a step-by-step guide per service, with warnings about known dark patterns. A cancellation is marked verified only once its renewal date passes with no new charge in the receipts or statements you scan or import.
- Privacy: subscription data is encrypted on the device; the app can be locked with a PIN (plus biometrics where the phone has them). Zeno never asks for bank credentials, and nothing is sold.

Pricing (USD):
- Free: up to 10 subscriptions, reminders, cancellation guides with verification, insights. No card required.
- Pro: $3.99 a month or $29.99 a year. Adds unlimited subscriptions, category budgets and envelope budgeting.
- Lifetime: $79.99 once. Everything in Pro, no renewal.
- Family: $6.99 a month for up to 5 people.
